leaders.name: Pastor Jose Kamonga
leaders.bio: Pastor Jose has been leading Cape Town Christian Tabernacle since its creation, he is the head Pastor. He has a heart for the work and people of God and lives to serve

leaders.name: Pastor Daniel Kabamba
leaders.bio: Pastor Daniel has been serving on this role for 2 years, he previously filled in the role of head of the deacon board position. He has a heart to serve always ready to help

leaders.name: Pastor Luc Yav
leaders.bio: Pastor Luc has been serving on this role for 2 years, he previously filled in the role of a treasurer for years. He has a heart to serve always ready to help
